whr2026_fig21.title: World Happiness Report 2026 — Data for Figure 2.1 (2011–2025)
whr2026_fig21.publisher: Wellbeing Research Centre, University of Oxford / Gallup / UN SDSN
whr2026_fig21.survey_years: Ranking years 2011–2025 (each a 3-year window ending that year)
whr2026_fig21.content: Rank, 3-year average life evaluation, 95% CI whiskers, six explained-by contributions
whr2026_fig21.methodology_note: Official 'Data for Figure 2.1' file. Ladder scores are 3-year averages of national Cantril-ladder responses from the Gallup World Poll. 'Explained by' columns are the WHR regression contributions of each factor relative to the hypothetical 'Dystopia' benchmark; their scale and coefficients differ between editions, so they are not compared across editions. This file stacks the historical ranking tables, so it is the longest official ranking series.
whr2026_fig21.role: Rankings, world map, historical trends, insights

whr2023_panel.title: World Happiness Report 2023 — DataForTable2.1 annual panel (2005–2022)
whr2023_panel.publisher: UN SDSN / Gallup World Poll (WHR 2023 statistical appendix data); obtained via the public Hugging Face mirror 'Slapping/Happiness' because the original S3 link now returns HTTP 403
whr2023_panel.content: Country, ISO-3, year, Life Ladder, log GDP pc, social support, healthy life expectancy, freedom, generosity, perceptions of corruption, positive affect, negative affect
whr2023_panel.methodology_note: Annual national means (single survey year, not 3-year averages). Because it is a third-party mirror it is verified on every acquisition: its 2020–2022 means must reproduce the official WHR 2023 Figure 2.1 ladder scores (see verification block in the manifest).
whr2023_panel.role: Primary dataset for EDA, statistics, machine learning, clustering and prediction
